prompt: Looking down from the landing above with a wide 24mm lens tilted off level, onto a tall gaunt Black man of about 45 on a rain-soaked iron fire escape, mid-chase, one long arm flung wide along the railing. His face fills a third of the frame, tipped up to us front-on: sharp jaw, sunken cheeks, narrow nose, small close ears, stubble, soaked homburg with water running off the brim behind his jaw, coat collar flat. The window right beside him is bursting outward, glass hanging in the air, amber room light spilling across his mouth. Magenta neon rain fills everything else, the wet iron stairs zigzagging away to a dark street far below where small torch beams search upward. Thanks.
